newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the panhandle area Thursday. Limited test slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

Wk to date - 131,100 Last Week - 92,300 Year Ago - 69,600 Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00, few pens North Plains 1100 lbs 65.00.
Sales reported on 600 slaughter steers and 700 heifers; 131,100 head confirmed for week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
